motions.purpose: Move attention along a chronology one event at a time; the gliding track preserves temporal order and neighborhood while the focused card opens.
motions.model: Ordinal slot layout by default; optional proportional 'time' scale positions events by numeric timestamp.
motions.limitations: Ordinal spacing does not encode elapsed time; event dates and claims are content and must be verified by the evidence workflow, not by this preset.
motions.reducedMotion: Track repositions instantly with no glide; focused detail opens without animation; nothing is hidden.
motions.exportState: Freeze at exportIndex (default 0) with the focused card open and all sibling events at full opacity.
motions.accessibility: Events are native buttons with date-and-title labels; arrow keys, Home and End navigate; a live status region announces position, era, and title.
